mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 4% in the month preceding the forecast period coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a pre-tightening baseline (p > 0.1) in at least 60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 50,000 for two consecutive months coincides with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investor sentiment deteriorates on labor market weakness.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in >70% of such labor weakness episodes, or unemployment recovers rapidly (<2% monthly) before the 60-day window closes.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month, followed by a subsequent month of flat CPI, the S&P 500 exhibits a positive 20-day forward return as investors anticipate future rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL month-over-month increase > 0.5%, and next month CPIAUCSL flat
regime_hint: Unexpected inflation surprise followed by stabilization
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of such CPI events, or subsequent core inflation (ex-CPI) rises above 0.3% in the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) index below 100 (annualized) for three consecutive months predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates a supply-side shock.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative in >80% of such episodes, or INDPRO recovers to trend before the 5-day window ends.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-week moving average of FEDFUNDS falls below 2%, the S&P 500 shows a positive 20-day forward return as markets anticipate easing and price in rate cuts.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.1) in >60% of such episodes, or 4-week moving average of FEDFUNDS does not re-enter >2.5% within 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.0% for a single month triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market tightness prompts optimism about economic strength.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in >70% of such episodes, or UNRATE does not sustain below 4.0% for more than one month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their prior month's levels indicates conflicting demand signals, leading to a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors become risk-averse.
Note: Cannot use GDP deflator as proxy; this sketch is replaced by an interaction-driven hypothesis using available proxies.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > prior_month and INDPRO > prior_month in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) in >80% of such events, or the interaction index (Rank IC) exceeds 0.05 over a 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in manufacturing activity (RSAFS) below 50 billion dollars for three consecutive months predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates a supply contraction and potential production slowdown.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative in >70% of such episodes, or RSAFS recovers to >55B within 3 months.
